results.title: GeM enters 11th year, connects over 1.37 lakh government buyer organisations with 25 lakh sellers
results.description: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has entered its 11th year, connecting over 1.37 lakh government buyer organisations with nearly 25 lakh sellers and service providers, facilitating procurement worth more than ₹20 lakh crore.

results.title: Bihar: Over 100 fall ill in Saharsa village with unknown illness
results.description: Over 100 people in Bihar's Saharsa district have fallen sick with vomiting, diarrhoea, and fever. Health officials confirmed that a few children are in serious condition and are being moved to a hospital. The cause of the illness is being investigated.

results.title: Jetstar and Qatar Airways near collision at Sydney Airport under investigation by Australian Transport Safety Bureau
results.description: Safety regulators are investigating a near collision between two passenger aircraft at Sydney Airport. A Jetstar pilot braked suddenly, avoiding a Qatar Airways jet under tow. One Jetstar cabin crew member sustained injuries during the abrupt stop. Investigations are underway to determine the cause of the incident. Flights at Sydney Airport are currently experiencing operational delays.

results.title: Renting out office for PFI doesn’t make it ‘proceeds of terrorism’: NIA court in Kerala
results.description: The petitioners submitted that the rental income from the property was their only source of livelihood and that they had no connection with the banned organisation, including the PFI.

results.title: Morgan Stanley on how to spot the 'madness of crowds' in markets
results.description: A Morgan Stanley report advises investors to scrutinize periods of strong consensus. It highlights that extreme sentiment, sharp price moves, and elevated valuations can signal a market's shift from 'wisdom' to the 'madness' of crowds.

results.title: Bulandshahr encounter: Man accused of rape, murder of minor killed
results.description: A wanted accused in the rape and murder of a minor girl was killed in a police encounter in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh. Police said two suspects on a motorcycle opened fire first, injuring two officers, before they returned fire in self-defence.

results.title: Karnataka forms ex-Chief Justice-led panel to review Bidadi Township
results.description: The four-member panel, headed by retired High Court judge Justice Guhanathan Narendar, will examine concerns over the 7,481-acre township project and submit its report within 30 days.
